links.comparator_used: Same e-consultation advice labeled as written by a "specialist attending physician" versus a "medically specialized artificial intelligence system" (randomized label)
links.outcome: Perceived quality ratings and adoption of e-consult recommendations
links.effect: Mean perceived quality ratings 4.2-4.7 out of 5 with no significant differences between randomization groups (all p > 0.05); labeling did not significantly affect adoption (OR 1.18, 95% CI 0.51-2.75; p = 0.70)
links.quote: Labeling the advice as human- or GAI-generated did not significantly affect adoption of e-consult recommendations (OR 1.18, 95% CI 0.51-2.75; p = 0.70).

design_hint: disclosure of AI vs human source of advice
